sentences.text:
Madan Sainy vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:28165
 1 Mc
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajesh Kumar Gupta
 On The 6 th Of November, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 50636 of 2025
 Madan Sainy
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Anand Purohit - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Harish Sharma - Pp for the State.

Order 
This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of interim bail relating to Crime No.66/2024 registered at Police Station - Ambah, District - Morena (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 307, 354, 376(d), 376(2) (d) and Section 302 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant / accused argued that the grandmother of the applicant has expired on 28.10.2025 and her thirteenth day rights are scheduled to be held of 08.11.2025.
The applicant is required to be present there.
Hence, he prayed to release the applicant on interim bail for the period of 15 days.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

However, he fairly admitted that factum of death and thirteenth day right has been verified and the same is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:28165 2 MCRC-50636-2025 scheduled to be held of 08.11.2025.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

In view of the documents filed by the applicant, present application is allowed and it is directed that applicant be released on temporary bail for a period of fifteen days i.e. till 21.11.2025 on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
